meta.title: Nabaperks merchant launch hub — frontend consolidation
meta.description: Frontend source for http://localhost:3000/app/launch: route, tabs, panels, forms, readiness spine, shell layout, brand/loyalty UI, and server actions the page calls. Each file includes full source in `code`.
meta.note: Server-only data modules (auth, Supabase, geocoding) are omitted; they are not UI source.
